title: Box form
purpose: Add a box to a rack or shelf, creating all its positions, or change the name of an existing box.

sections.title: Fields
paragraphs: Only the admin and manager roles can open or submit this form.
Confirm the physical box matches the container type's grid. The box's grid and location cannot be edited later; use Move to relocate it.

items.label: Rack or shelf
items.description: Create only. Required; active nodes that offer box slots, shown with their unit and path. Preselected when opened from a node page.

items.label: Box slot
items.description: Create only. Required whole number from 1 to the node's box slots; must be free of another active box. Opened from a node page, it starts at the first free slot.

items.label: Container type
items.description: Create only. Required; active container types. Every position is created with the box and the grid never changes.

items.label: Code
items.description: Create only. Up to 40 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit. Stored in capitals. It can never be changed or reused, even after retirement.

items.label: Name
items.description: Optional, up to 160 characters; the code is used when blank.

items.label: Reason for the change
items.description: Edit only. Required, up to 2000 characters. Kept in the history.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Editing needs a reason (up to 2000 characters), which is kept in the history with the values before and after. Creating records the setup without asking for a reason. If the record changed since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay on the page, but check the current values before saving again. A save with nothing changed is refused.

items.label: Create box / Save changes
items.description: Creating saves the box and all its positions together and reports the number created, then opens the box.
